text_en: Wives, in the same way, accept the authority of your husbands, so that, even if some of them do not obey the word, they may be won over without a word by their wives’ conduct,
text_cn: 同样，你们做妻子的，应当服从自己的丈夫，好叫那些不信从天主话的，为了妻子无言的品行而受感化，

text_en: when they see the purity and reverence of your lives.
text_cn: 因为他们看见了，你们怀有敬畏的贞洁品行。

text_en: Do not adorn yourselves outwardly by braiding your hair, and by wearing gold ornaments or fine clothing;
text_cn: 你们的装饰不应是外面的发型、金饰或衣服的装束，

text_en: rather, let your adornment be the inner self with the lasting beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.
text_cn: 而应是那藏于内心，基于不朽的温柔，和宁静心神的人格：这在天主前才是宝贵的。

text_en: It was in this way long ago that the holy women who hoped in God used to adorn themselves by accepting the authority of their husbands.
text_cn: 从前那些仰望天主的圣妇，正是这样装饰了自己，服从了自己的丈夫。

text_en: Thus Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him lord. You have become her daughters as long as you do what is good and never let fears alarm you.
text_cn: 就如撒辣听从了亚巴郎，称他为“主”；你们如果行善，不害怕任何恐吓，你们就是她的女儿。

text_en: Husbands, in the same way, show consideration for your wives in your life together, paying honor to the woman as the weaker sex, since they too are also heirs of the gracious gift of life—so that nothing may hinder your prayers.
text_cn: 同样，你们作丈夫的，应该凭着信仰的智慧与妻子同居，待她们有如较为脆弱的器皿，尊敬她们，有如与你们共享生命恩宠的继承人：这样你们的祈祷便不会受到阻碍。

text_en: Finally, all of you, have unity of spirit, sympathy, love for one another, a tender heart, and a humble mind.
text_cn: 总之，你们都该同心合意，互表同情，友爱弟兄，慈悲为怀，谦逊温和；

text_en: Do not repay evil for evil or abuse for abuse; but, on the contrary, repay with a blessing. It is for this that you were called—that you might inherit a blessing.
text_cn: 总不要以恶报恶，以骂还骂；但要祝福，因为你们原是为继承祝福而蒙召的。

text_en: For “Those who desire life and desire to see good days, let them keep their tongues from evil and their lips from speaking deceit;
text_cn: 所以“凡愿意爱惜生命，和愿意享见幸福日子的，就应谨守口舌，不说坏话，克制嘴唇，不言欺诈；

text_en: let them turn away from evil and do good; let them seek peace and pursue it.
text_cn: 躲避邪恶，努力行善，寻求和平，全心追随，

text_en: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears are open to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil. ”
text_cn: 因为上主的双目垂顾正义的人，他的两耳俯听他们的哀声；但上主的威容敌视作恶的人。”

text_en: Now who will harm you if you are eager to do what is good?
text_cn: 如果你们热心行善，谁能加害你们呢？

text_en: But even if you do suffer for doing what is right, you are blessed. Do not fear what they fear, and do not be intimidated,
text_cn: 但若你们为正义而受苦，才是有福的。你们不要害怕人们的恐吓，也不要心乱。

text_en: but in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be ready to make your defense to anyone who demands from you an accounting for the hope that is in you;
text_cn: 你们但要在心内尊崇基督为主；若有人询问你们心中所怀希望的理由，你们要时常准备答复，

text_en: yet do it with gentleness and reverence. Keep your conscience clear, so that, when you are maligned, those who abuse you for your good conduct in Christ may be put to shame.
text_cn: 且要以温和、以敬畏之心答复，保持纯洁的良心，好使那些诬告你们在基督内有良好品行的人，在他们诽谤你们的事上，感到羞愧。

text_en: For it is better to suffer for doing good, if suffering should be God’s will, than to suffer for doing evil.
text_cn: 若天主的旨意要你们因行善而受苦，自然比作恶而受苦更好，

text_en: For Christ also suffered for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, in order to bring you to God. He was put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the spirit,
text_cn: 因为基督也曾一次为罪而死，且是义人代替不义的人，为将我们领到天主面前；就肉身说，他固然被处死了；但就神魂说，他却复活了。

text_en: in which also he went and made a proclamation to the spirits in prison,
text_cn: 他藉这神魂，曾去给那些在狱中的灵魂宣讲过；

text_en: who in former times did not obey, when God waited patiently in the days of Noah, during the building of the ark, in which a few, that is, eight persons, were saved through water.
text_cn: 这些灵魂从前在诺厄建造方舟的时日，天主耐心期待之时，原是不信的人；当时赖方舟经过水而得救的不多，只有八个生灵。

text_en: And baptism, which this prefigured, now saves you—not as a removal of dirt from the body, but as an appeal to God for a good conscience, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
text_cn: 这水所预表的圣洗，如今赖耶稣基督的复活拯救了你们，并不是涤除肉体的污秽，而是向天主要求一纯洁的良心。

text_en: who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of God, with angels, authorities, and powers made subject to him.
text_cn: 至于耶稣基督，他升了天，坐在天主的右边， 众天使、掌权者和异能者都屈服在他权下。
